title: Ibm Security Advisories - 2026-09-11
description:
Merged 3 ibm security advisories published on 2026-09-11. Original advisory IDs: IBM-7287209, IBM-7287172, IBM-7287190

Titles:
- IBM Cognos Analytics versions 12.0.4 and 12.1.3 is affected by security vulnerabilities
- Multiple Vulnerabilities in IBM Library Support for Spring
- The Dashboard of IBM Sterling B2B Integrator and IBM Sterling File Gateway are Vulnerable to Improper Access Control (CVE-2026-19273)

cves.title: CVE-2017-16026
cves.description: Starlette is a lightweight ASGI framework or toolkit. Prior to version 1.0.1, the HTTP `Host` request header was not validated before being used to reconstruct `request.url`. Because the routing algorithm relies on the raw HTTP path while `request.url` is rebuilt from the `Host` header, a malformed header could make `request.url.path` differ from the path that was actually requested. Middleware and endpoints that apply security restrictions based on `request.url` (rather than the raw `scope` path) could therefore be bypassed. Users should upgrade to a version greater than or equal to version 1.0.1, which validates the `Host` header against the grammar of RFC 9112 §3.2 or RFC 3986 §3.2.2 when constructing `request.url` and falls back to `scope[server]` for malformed values

cves.title: CVE-2026-4800
cves.description: Starlette is a lightweight ASGI framework or toolkit. Prior to version 1.0.1, the HTTP `Host` request header was not validated before being used to reconstruct `request.url`. Because the routing algorithm relies on the raw HTTP path while `request.url` is rebuilt from the `Host` header, a malformed header could make `request.url.path` differ from the path that was actually requested. Middleware and endpoints that apply security restrictions based on `request.url` (rather than the raw `scope` path) could therefore be bypassed. Users should upgrade to a version greater than or equal to version 1.0.1, which validates the `Host` header against the grammar of RFC 9112 §3.2 or RFC 3986 §3.2.2 when constructing `request.url` and falls back to `scope[server]` for malformed values

cves.title: CVE-2026-59935
cves.description: Starlette is a lightweight ASGI framework or toolkit. Prior to version 1.0.1, the HTTP `Host` request header was not validated before being used to reconstruct `request.url`. Because the routing algorithm relies on the raw HTTP path while `request.url` is rebuilt from the `Host` header, a malformed header could make `request.url.path` differ from the path that was actually requested. Middleware and endpoints that apply security restrictions based on `request.url` (rather than the raw `scope` path) could therefore be bypassed. Users should upgrade to a version greater than or equal to version 1.0.1, which validates the `Host` header against the grammar of RFC 9112 §3.2 or RFC 3986 §3.2.2 when constructing `request.url` and falls back to `scope[server]` for malformed values
